Class RequestMessage

java.lang.Object
net.apexes.fetion4j.core.sipc.SipcMessage
net.apexes.fetion4j.core.sipc.RequestMessage
public class RequestMessage extends SipcMessage
SIPC request message sent from the client to the server. Carries an acceptor (destination host) and method, and produces a headline in the format METHOD acceptor SIP-C/4.0.
Since:
3.0.0
